goal: Allow wallets to send an initial transaction broadcast without recurring rebroadcasts
Prevents leaking transaction ownership to the network over time for privacy-conscious users
agreement: Objections to disabling rebroadcasts by default were addressed by preserving default behavior (achow101, vicjuma)
Adopted suggestion to extend existing broadcast setting instead of adding a new option (w0xlt)
Unaddressed suggestion to also disable mempool resubmission when rebroadcasts are disabled (mzumsande)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it lets privacy-conscious users avoid transaction ownership leaks from rebroadcasts
Default behavior is unchanged and the opt-in privacy feature is reasonably deferrable
